thread:
Emma (sales): Heads-up — MediWell (healthcare POC) asked for SOC2 artifacts, an ISO scope summary, and a signed pen-test letter before we hand over dedicated staging. They also want a ballpark for a 2-week burst if we provide presigned staging creds. Need a minimal send-by-EOD pack and a safe staging checklist.

Raj (solutions): We can bundle SOC2 attestation PDF, SOC2 control-map one-pager, ISO scope + exclusions, pen-test letter template, redacted network diagram, and KMS attestation. Who owns the pen-test signature?

Olivia (eng-ops): I can provision staging after Legal confirms residency. For creds: ephemeral S3 presigned uploads + short-lived STS role. Need IP ranges to whitelist. Will set lifecycle delete and a 2-hour smoke test window.

Mike (security): Pen-test letter must include: explicit scope (staging-only), allowed tests (no social engineering, no physical), target IP ranges, emergency pause contact, and signatory. For PHI we recommend Private + customer-managed KMS. If hosted staging is allowed: presign expiry <=24h (prefer 12h), rotate ephemeral roles frequently, and keep immutable audit logs.

compliance-bot: SOC2 attestation available at /dataroom/soc2/Redwood_Soc2_Attestation_2025.pdf

Emma (sales): Procurement asked for a quick number for a 2-week reserved burst vs pure on-demand so they can pre-approve spend. Simple ballpark OK.

Olivia (eng-ops): POC estimate: seq_len 1024, ~50 reqs/min peak, batching ~8. Baseline ~12 GPU-hours/day. For 14 days with spikes plan ~250 GPU-hours. Quick calc: 250 hours * $3.50/hr ≈ $875 infra. Add ops/support and presign handling — recommend quoting $1.4k–$1.8k as conservative bundle.

Raj (solutions): I will draft the control-map and pen-test template then upload to the dataroom and tag @Mike/@Olivia.

Emma (sales): Great. I'll consolidate the pack + pricing note + staging runbook and send to MediWell by EOD. Please drop drafts/links here. :thumbsup:
